instructions: Choose one ordinary mouse input on the current screenshot. Coordinates cover the whole game window. A left press starts a path when none is active; pointer movement extends that path even after the button is released. The next left press submits the active path. A drag performs a left press, straight movement and release; if a path is already active, its initial press submits that path. These descriptions explain controls only.

left_click.description: Left-click a location in the current game window.

move_pointer.description: Move the pointer to a location without pressing a mouse button.

left_drag.description: Press the left mouse button at a chosen start, move straight to a chosen endpoint, and release.
